visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Swap Pointers Instead of Copying Text
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Words stored in a two-dimensional char array are sorted by copying their characters with strcpy three times per swap. Store pointers to the words and swap those instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Swapping two pointers moves 8 bytes while strcpy-ing each word copies all its characters three times. It also removes the fixed 10-character limit of the char array.
